title: A Large-Dimensional Analysis of Least-Squares Federated Learning via Generalized Total Variation Minimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.20075v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated learning over decentralized networks inherently trades off the suppression of local finite-sample noise through collaboration against the bias that collaboration introduces between heterogeneous nodes. We study this tension by performing a large-dimensional analysis of Generalized Total Variation Minimization with least-squares models. Using tools from random matrix theory, we show that Lipschitz observations of the global GTVMin solution concentrate in large dimensions, universally for any underlying network structure. We provide exact analytic expressions for the asymptotically precise performance under both i.i.d. and non-i.i.d. Gaussian mixture distributions on a fixed network. For the latter, these expressions quantify how regularization balances local adaptation against collaboration. Our theoretical results are confirmed by experiments on synthetic and real-world data.

translated_title: 基于广义全变差最小化的最小二乘联邦学习的大维度分析
translated_abstract: 去中心化网络上的联邦学习本质上是在通过协作抑制局部有限样本噪声与协作在异构节点之间引入的偏差之间进行权衡。我们通过对基于最小二乘模型的广义全变差最小化进行大维度分析来研究这种张力。利用随机矩阵理论的工具，我们证明了全局GTVMin解的Lipschitz观测在大维度下是集中的，且对任何底层网络结构都普遍成立。我们提供了在固定网络上独立同分布与非独立同分布高斯混合分布下渐近精确性能的精确解析表达式。对于后者，这些表达式量化了正则化如何在局部适应与协作之间取得平衡。我们的理论结果通过合成数据和真实世界数据的实验得到了验证。
tldr: 本文通过随机矩阵理论对基于广义全变差最小化的最小二乘联邦学习进行大维度分析，给出了独立同分布与非独立同分布高斯混合数据下渐近精确性能的精确解析表达式，量化了正则化如何在局部适应与协作之间进行权衡。
